KSSR Stories · Year 6.text: Last month the town started a new bus route for the villages along the river. Before this, the only transport was a lorry that came twice a week, and most families had to walk to the main road. The bus leaves the terminal at six in the morning and reaches the last village at nine. A driver and a conductor collect the ticket from each passenger. The journey takes about fifty minutes, but the village is now connected to the hospital and the market. An old woman in my village can finally keep her monthly appointment with the doctor. The operator says the route will only continue if enough people use it every day.
